invariants.rule: Registry must deterministically synthesize all 6 universal archetypes (Backend_API, FullStack_Web, Data_ML_Pipeline, CLI_SDK, Autonomous_Agent, Embedded_IoT) and 5 language toolchains (python, typescript, go, rust, generic) with polymorphic proof bindings.

Ignite compiler must pass research_briefing.md through UntrustedContentEnvelope (stripping prompt injections and redacting secrets) before synthesizing IntentContract; --init-new-project initializes a clean seq:0 journal.
Worktree executor must allocate an ephemeral git worktree under /tmp, run tests without mutating the primary repository working tree, and clean up the worktree on exit.

Triple RED Oracle (V12-05) must reject syntax/import/collection errors as false RED, require CompilationSuccess==True && RuntimeExecution=='EXECUTED' && TestExitCode!=0, bind every failed test to an AcceptanceOracle.oracle_id, and produce identical failure sets across two runs with the same seed.
Proof assembler must emit Ed25519-signed CompleteProofReceiptPackage with Pillar 9.2 Meta-Metrics to receipts/by-run/<run_id>/<receipt_hash>.json and update receipts/pointers/latest_proof.json.
Cockpit projector must generate DASHBOARD.md, STATE_GRAPH.md, DECISION_QUEUE.md, and EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md with zero LLM tokens (llm_tokens_used == 0), valid [[wikilink]] links, and Mermaid diagrams.
All projected Obsidian Markdown views and proof artifacts must pass secrets.scan_text with zero secret pattern hits.
docs/IGNITE_GUIDE.md and .antigravity/genesis/templates/ must cover the full NotebookLM -> Antigravity -> Obsidian workflow in Turkish and execute within performance budgets.
